content: Obesity is a risk factor for the development of several cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecologic carcinomas.¹˒² Recently, it has become clear that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis of various cancers. For instance, obesity has been associated with poor prognosis in breast³˒⁴ and colon⁵˒⁶ cancers, whereas favorable prognoses have been reported in obese patients with gastric⁷ and renal⁸ cancers.
